args.query: Celery task with automatic retries and exponential backoff using Redis broker

results.title: Celery 5 on Redis with fakeredis-backed idempotency, tested offline in eager mode
results.summary: Configure a Celery app on a Redis broker and result backend for production, guard a task with a Redis SET NX idempotency lock, and test it offline with task_always_eager and fakeredis.

results.title: Django post_save signal enqueuing a Celery task, tested with eager mode and on_commit
results.summary: A post_save signal queues a Celery task only after the row commits via transaction.on_commit, then tests run offline on in-memory SQLite with Celery eager mode and pytest-django's on_commit capture.

results.title: Celery 5 tasks, chains and groups tested in eager mode
results.summary: Define Celery tasks, chain and fan them out with groups, then test them offline with task_always_eager and the in-memory broker.

results.title: redis-py pipelines and WATCH transactions tested with fakeredis
results.summary: Batch commands with redis-py pipelines and guard optimistic WATCH/MULTI transactions, tested fully offline against a shared in-memory fakeredis server.

results.title: Celery beat crontab schedules validated and run eagerly
results.summary: Define beat_schedule crontab entries, validate task names and schedule types before deploy, and test each scheduled call offline with task_always_eager.

results.title: Effect 4 Schema classes, typed errors and retries, tested with @effect/vitest
results.summary: Effect 4 Schema.Class models with checks, brands, FiniteFromString and fromJsonString for decode and encode, TaggedError failures, and Effect.retry with exponential backoff verified on the TestClock using @effect/vitest.

results.title: httpx + tenacity async retries honoring Retry-After, tested with respx
results.summary: Wrap async httpx calls in tenacity AsyncRetrying that retries 429 and 5xx, honors Retry-After, and patches the wait to zero in tests with respx mocks.

results.title: Axios + axios-retry with exponential backoff, tested with nock
results.summary: Configure axios-retry for idempotent requests and 429/5xx responses, tested offline with nock intercepts.

results.title: httpx client + tenacity retries with backoff, tested with respx
results.summary: Retry transient HTTP failures (5xx, 429, timeouts) with tenacity around an httpx client, honoring a max attempt count, tested offline with respx.

results.title: tenacity Retrying with stop_after_attempt and wait_exponential
results.summary: Build a tenacity Retrying policy that stops after N attempts, backs off exponentially and only retries transient exception types, then prove the behavior offline under pytest.
